cards.ex: Work's been hectic, but can't complain, really.
cards.exUz: Ish juda band bo'ldi, lekin shikoyat qila olmayman, rost.
cards.uzDef: Hammasi yaxshi, shikoyat qilishga arziydigan narsa yo'qmi?

cards.ex: You bumped into me, but no harm done, I'm fine.
cards.exUz: Siz menga urildingiz, lekin hech qanday zarar yo'q, men yaxshiman.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday zarar yetmaganmi, muammo yo'qmi?

cards.ex: Hey, anything new since we last spoke?
cards.exUz: Salom, oxirgi marta gaplashganimizdan beri yangi gap bormi?
cards.uzDef: So'nggi paytlarda biron yangilik bo'ldimi?

cards.ex: That traffic is awful. Don't I know it!
cards.exUz: Bu tirbandlik dahshatli. Buni juda yaxshi bilaman!
cards.uzDef: Men ham xuddi shunday fikrdaman, juda yaxshi bilaman.

cards.ex: He quit his job? Is that right? I'm shocked.
cards.exUz: U ishdan bo'shabdimi? Rostdanmi? Men hayronman.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatan ham shundaymi, ishonish qiyin.

cards.ex: Well, did I ask for your opinion? No, I didn't.
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, sizning fikringizni so'radimmi? Yo'q, so'ramadim.
cards.uzDef: Sizning fikringizni so'ramadim, kerak emas edi.

cards.ex: You're moving to Spain? Is that so? How exciting!
cards.exUz: Ispaniyaga ko'chib o'tyapsizmi? Shundaymi? Qanday hayajonli!
cards.uzDef: Shunday bo'lganmi, qiziqarli yangilik.

cards.ex: What's the point of arguing? It won't change anything.
cards.exUz: Bahslashishning ma'nosi nima? Bu hech narsani o'zgartirmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Buning maqsadi nima, undan nima foyda?

cards.ex: He said he won the lottery, but you buying that?
cards.exUz: U lotereyada yutdim dedi, lekin unga ishonyapsanmi?
cards.uzDef: Siz bunga ishonyapsizmi, bu haqiqatga o'xshaydimi?

cards.ex: How many cookies did I eat? Who's counting?
cards.exUz: Men nechta pechene yedim? Kim sanaydi?
cards.uzDef: Buni hech kim sanamaydi, ahamiyati yo'q.

cards.ex: That movie was terrible, am I right?
cards.exUz: Bu film dahshatli edi, to'g'rimi?
cards.uzDef: Men to'g'ri aytyapmanmi, shunday emasmi?

cards.ex: The project failed. What can I say? We tried our best.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi. Nima deyman? Biz qo'limizdan kelgancha harakat qildik.
cards.uzDef: Men hech narsa qila olmayman, men aybdor emasman.

cards.ex: Made a mistake at work? Haven't we all?
cards.exUz: Ishda xato qildingizmi? Hammaga shunday emasmi?
cards.uzDef: Hammaga shunday bo'lgan, bu umumiy tajriba.

cards.ex: Where did he go? How should I know?
cards.exUz: U qayerga ketdi? Qayerdan bilay?
cards.uzDef: Men bilmayman, qanday qilib bilishim mumkin?

cards.ex: He's quitting his job? You gotta be kidding?
cards.exUz: U ishdan bo'shamoqdami? Hazillashyapsanmi?
cards.uzDef: Sen hazillashyapsanmi, bu haqiqat bo'lishi mumkin emas.

cards.ex: Any chance of that happening again?
cards.exUz: Buning yana sodir bo'lish imkoniyati bormi?
cards.uzDef: Buning imkoniyati bormi, sodir bo'lish ehtimoli bormi?

cards.ex: We lost the game, but what's done is done.
cards.exUz: Biz o'yinda yutqazdik, lekin o'tdi-ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Bo'ldi, tugadi, o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.

cards.ex: So, what's your take on the new policy?
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, yangi siyosatga fikring qanday?
cards.uzDef: Sizning fikringiz qanday, siz nima deb o'ylaysiz?

cards.ex: They made a mistake, but who am I to judge?
cards.exUz: Ular xato qilishdi, lekin men kimman hukm qilishga?
cards.uzDef: Men hukm qilishga haqqim yo'q, boshqalarni tanqid qilmayman.

cards.ex: We're waiting. What's the hold-up?
cards.exUz: Biz kutmoqdamiz. Nega kechikish?
cards.uzDef: Nima kechikishga sabab bo'ldi, nima to'sqinlik qilyapti?

cards.ex: I mentioned his name. Does it ring a bell?
cards.exUz: Men uning ismini tilga oldim. Eslatmaydimi?
cards.uzDef: Bu sizga tanish tuyulmaydimi, esingizga tushmaydimi?

cards.ex: So he's late. What's the big deal?
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, u kechikdi. Nimasi muhim?
cards.uzDef: Buning nimasi muhim, nega bunchalik jiddiy qabul qilyapsiz?

cards.ex: After all the details, what's the bottom line?
cards.exUz: Barcha tafsilotlardan so'ng, asosiy xulosa nima?
cards.uzDef: Eng muhim xulosa nima, asosiy nuqta nimadan iborat?

cards.ex: Mind if I open the window?
cards.exUz: Agar derazani ochsam, xafa bo'lmaysizmi?
cards.uzDef: Agar shunday qilsam, xafa bo'lmaysizmi?

cards.ex: This plan will never work. Who are we kidding?
cards.exUz: Bu reja hech qachon ishlamaydi. Kimni aldayapmiz?
cards.uzDef: O'zimizni aldayapmiz, bu haqiqat emasligini bilamiz.

cards.ex: I don't understand. What's your point?
cards.exUz: Men tushunmayapman. Maqsading nima?
cards.uzDef: Nimani aytmoqchisiz, maqsad nima?

cards.ex: He won't listen. What am I to do?
cards.exUz: U quloq solmaydi. Nima qilay?
cards.uzDef: Men nima qilishim kerak, menga maslahat bering.

cards.ex: Is that all there is to the story?
cards.exUz: Hikoyada shu xolosmi?
cards.uzDef: Boshqa hech narsa yo'qmi, shu bilan tugadimi?

cards.ex: Are you following me so far?
cards.exUz: Hozirgacha meni tushunyapsanmi?
cards.uzDef: Meni tushunyapsanmi, aytayotganlarimga ergashyapsanmi?

cards.ex: So, what's the verdict on the new restaurant?
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, yangi restoran haqida hukm qanday?
cards.uzDef: Natija qanday, qaror qabul qilindingizmi?
